Subject: New req: Billing Ops - Senior Associate (headcount + band exception)

Hi Vivek / Karthik,

We're ready to move forward with the Billing Ops Senior Associate req (Greenhouse ID RED-4532). Monica has identified a strong candidate through RavenSearch (Harper Jones) and is requesting an offer at the top of Band 4 — which is outside our standard band midpoint by ~12%. Given the market for payments/reconciliation specialists and the operational risk if we miss this hire (month-end backlog + two open positions), Monica is asking for a band exception and headcount approval to extend an offer this week.

Quick facts:
- Role: Billing Ops - Senior Associate (IC)
- Team owner: Monica Patel (Billing Ops)
- Req ID: RED-4532 (Greenhouse)
- Candidate: Harper Jones (RavenSearch) — currently at PayFlow as Sr. Billing Specialist
- Proposed offer: $128,000 base + standard equity (Band 4 top is $115,000)
- Start: ASAP / 3 weeks notice preferred

Attachments: JD_BillingOps_SeniorAssoc.pdf, comp-band-comparison_2026-02.xlsx, req-approval-form.pdf

Ask: can FP&A confirm budget availability and sign off on a one-time band exception for this specific candidate? Karthik — please confirm the headcount is fundable under current billing ops forecast or whether we need to reallocate. Vivek — would appreciate a quick yes/no so Talent can issue an offer.

If helpful, Monica and I can jump on a 15-min sync today.

Thanks,
Marissa

Head of RevOps (acting)

Subject: Re: New req: Billing Ops - Senior Associate (headcount + band exception)

Thanks Marissa — couple of quick questions before I can sign off:

1) Are there any near-term planned hires (next 90 days) in Billing Ops beyond this req that would consume the same budget slice?
2) Is this candidate replacing an open headcount or an incremental one? I recall Monica mentioned two open IC roles; need clarity for run-rate calculations.
3) Can you share the comp-bench tab in the spreadsheet with peer recent hires (we have the high-level sheet, but need the hire comps to justify exception).

If this is incremental headcount, we can fund it from the Recruiting Reserve (Q1 contingency) but I need Karthik to confirm the transfer doesn't break month cadence. Assuming we can cover, I think a one-time exception to match market makes sense for a critical ops hire — provided we cap the exception to a signing bonus instead of moving band permanently.

Please respond by EOD — I can approve contingent on Karthik confirming the funds.

—Vivek

Director, FP&A

Folks — answering Vivek's Qs inline: 
1) No other Billing Ops hires planned in the next 90 days; we're pausing one req (RED-4509) due to process cleanup.
2) This is for an incrementally funded headcount that was budgeted for H1 as part of increased invoice volume forecast — not a backfill.
3) Uploaded a small comp packet to the sheet (tab: hire-comps) — includes two recent vendors and the candidate's current comp.

Operational note: if we don't get this person in March we will not hit our target SLA for invoice aging in April — which creates downstream slippage for Rev recognition handoffs. Harper has relevant Stripe/payments reconciliation experience and can shorten onboarding to 3 weeks.

Requesting FP&A approval to:
- Approve the incremental headcount (H1 budget allocation)
- Grant a one-time band exception: increase Band 4 top to $130k for this candidate only (no permanent band shift)
- Approve a $6k sign-on bonus (paid in two installments) to bridge comp without changing band structures

I've attached the candidate resume (sent separately by RavenSearch) and the updated comp sheet. Happy to join a quick call if you want to review the hire comps live.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Manager, Billing Operations

Conditions of approval:
- Headcount: approved (RED-4532) — Karthik to update budget ledger and reassign Q1 contingency to Billing Ops by COB next Tuesday.
- Band exception: approved as a one-time exception up to $130k total base for this candidate only; no change to official band tables. HR to mark exception stamping in the compensation system.
- Sign-on: approve $6k sign-on, tied to a 6-month clawback schedule if employee leaves within 6 months.
- Offer cadence: Talent to send offer by 3/3/2026 or we retract approval.

Marissa / Monica: please work with Talent (RavenSearch and internal TA) to get the offer finalized. Karthik — ping me when the budget reallocation is posted so I can sign the PO if necessary.
